conventions.convention: Signature is (-+++); R(X,Y)Z = ∇X∇YZ − ∇Y∇XZ − ∇[X,Y]Z. Geometric electrovac means dF = d(⋆F) = 0 and Ric = 2Q(F), with zero cosmological constant. These are mathematical model equations, without empirical assertions.

The Hodge map uses the metric volume orientation and squares to −identity on two-forms. Electric and magnetic flux parameters are respectively (4π)⁻¹∫S ⋆F and (4π)⁻¹∫S F, for independently oriented compact embedded spheres. The integration background retains countable choice.

RN has positive radius, an arbitrary open radial set J excluding every zero of f, outward sphere orientation, spacetime orientation dx⁰∧dr∧ω, and F = −q_e r⁻² dx⁰∧dr + q_m ω. Time orientation is ∂x⁰ where f>0 and ∂r where f<0.
The Boyer–Lindquist datum is defined only where Σ>0, Δ≠0 and 0<θ<π; negative radius is permitted. Its potential is −qrΣ⁻¹(dx⁰−a sin²θ dφ). The definition supplies no values at horizons, axes or Σ=0.

The full-sphere KN extension is the separately defined smooth product exterior r>R₀>4|M|, with global sphere form λ=X dY−Y dX, time orientation ∂x⁰ and orientation dx⁰∧dr∧ω. It asserts no horizon or maximal extension.

Exact rational verification takes place over Frac(Q[r,y,M,a,q]), with δ₀=δ₃=0, δ₁=∂r and δ₂=∂y. Every introduced divisor remains an admissibility condition; zero flags test polynomial numerators, not parameter samples. Signature and the volume identity are supplied hypotheses.

load_bearing.statement: A geometric electrovac datum with zero cosmological constant satisfies dF=0, d(⋆gF)=0 and Ric_ab=2Q_ab(F) at every point, with the stated smooth oriented, time-oriented Lorentzian geometry and flux normalization.

On Σ>0, Δ≠0 and 0<θ<π, the exact rational calculation returns zero numerator flags for all four Maxwell-density residuals and all sixteen Einstein residuals, scalar curvature zero, and Ricci-square 4q⁴/Σ⁴, together with its displayed Maxwell scalar.

For real M,q_e,q_m and every open J⊂(0,∞) with f≠0, the RN Ricci components are the displayed diagonal table, scalar curvature is zero, Ricci-square is 4Q⁴/r⁸, and the Kretschmann scalar is 48M²/r⁶−96MQ²/r⁷+56Q⁴/r⁸, including on f<0 components.

For every admissible algorithm input, each returned rational pair represents its scheduled expression; its numerator-zero flag is true iff that expression is zero in the fraction field. On a real chart with all recorded divisors nonzero and the supplied volume identity, a zero flag certifies the coordinate identity.
For real M,a,q, the KN metric and potential satisfy the geometric electrovac equations on every pole-free Boyer–Lindquist domain with Σ>0 and Δ≠0, and on every full-sphere exterior r>R₀>4|M|.
For a smooth geometric electrovac datum and constant real β, Fβ=cosβ F+sinβ ⋆gF has dFβ=d(⋆gFβ)=0 and Q(Fβ)=Q(F), so the same metric satisfies the rotated Ricci equation.

seams_checked.note: The RN and KN theorems use the explicitly defined quadratic tensor and formal positive-constant normalization from lem-emg-maxwell-observer-stress(d). They preserve the separate fixed-sector hypotheses for its Hilbert-tensor interpretation and acknowledge its draft status.

The curvature propositions use clause (e) of def-emg-causal-solution-and-horizon-vocabulary only for specified approached points of C² nondegenerate extensions. Their diverging scalar contractions support precisely those approach obstructions, without asserting maximality or geodesic incompleteness.

The normalization chain retains the positive-square-root and fixed-sector qualifications inherited through the stress supplier. RN local magnetic potentials and KN dual rotations explicitly avoid claiming a circle-bundle realization or quantization for arbitrary real flux.

The ingoing RN definition explicitly distinguishes its interior time orientation from the static RN choice. RN crossing and KN extension use the geometric equations on their actual root-free domains, then invoke smooth continuation; the charged-ring consumer retains q≠0 and the exact Ricci-square interface.

The family verifications preserve the geometric equations and normalization. The MP-to-RN identification uses only the common positive-radius extremal exterior, and the near-horizon consumer starts with M=q_e=L>0 and r>L. Sphere-flux uses preserve the outward orientation convention.
